items.title: Anthropic surpasses OpenAI to become most valuable AI startup
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 422 points, 472 comments | linked site: qazinform.com | submitted by Bolat14

Article description: Anthropic has become the most valuable artificial intelligence startup in the world, surpassing OpenAI in market valuation. Following a new funding round, the valuation of the developer behind the Claude AI assistant has approached the $1 trillion mark, reports a Qazinform News Agency correspondent.
items.title_zh: Anthropic 超越 OpenAI，成为全球估值最高的 AI 初创公司
items.summary: Hacker News front page (422 points, 472 comments) on a report that Anthropic has overtaken OpenAI as the world's most valuable AI startup, with its valuation approaching $1 trillion after a new funding round.

items.title: IBM Spins Off the First Pure-Play Quantum Chip Foundry
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 158 points, 73 comments | linked site: futurumgroup.com | submitted by rbanffy

Article description: IBM's CHIPS Act Investment of $2 billion establishes Anderon, America's first pure-play quantum chip foundry as part of investments in nine companies.
items.title_zh: IBM 分拆出首家纯晶圆代工模式的量子芯片代工厂
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News discussion (158 points, 73 comments) of a report that IBM's $2 billion CHIPS Act investment establishes Anderon, described as America's first pure-play quantum chip foundry, as part of investments in nine companies.

items.title: Anthropic raises $65B in Series H funding at $965B post-money valuation
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 362 points, 430 comments | linked site: anthropic.com | submitted by meetpateltech

Article description: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital.
items.title_zh: Anthropic 以 9650 亿美元投后估值完成 650 亿美元 H 轮融资
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (362 points, 430 comments) of Anthropic's announcement that it raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital, at a $965 billion post-money valuation.

items.summary: Hacker News front page (607 points, 234 comments) discusses a Politico Europe report that the Netherlands blocked a US takeover of a vital digital supplier, amid European concerns over reliance on American technology.

items.title: ChatGPT for Google Sheets exfiltrates workbooks
items.raw_content:
Hacker News score: 324 points, 121 comments | linked site: promptarmor.com | submitted by hackerBanana

Article description: ChatGPT for Google Sheets is vulnerable to data exfiltration and phishing overlay attacks that affect workbooks across the victim’s account after an indirect prompt injection in a single sheet.
items.title_zh: Google Sheets 版 ChatGPT 可窃取整本工作簿
items.summary: PromptArmor reports that ChatGPT for Google Sheets is vulnerable to data exfiltration and phishing overlay attacks affecting workbooks across a victim's account after an indirect prompt injection in a single sheet. Hacker News: 324 points, 121 comments.

items.title: A few interesting modern pixel fonts
items.title_zh: 几款有趣的现代像素字体
items.summary: Front-page Hacker News discussion (418 points, 112 comments) of a post at unsung.aresluna.org titled "A few interesting modern pixel fonts".

items.title: Taking a walk may lead to more creativity than sitting, study finds (2014)
items.title_zh: 研究发现：散步可能比坐着更有助于创造力（2014）
items.summary: An American Psychological Association press release from 2014 describing research that found walking may lead to more creativity than sitting; the item drew 616 points and 235 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Outsourcing plus local AI will soon become more economical vs. frontier labs
items.title_zh: 外包加本地 AI 很快将比前沿实验室更经济
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (323 points, 374 comments) of a SignalBloom essay arguing that combining outsourcing with locally run AI models will soon prove more economical than relying on frontier labs.

items.title: I'm Tired of Talking to AI
items.title_zh: 我厌倦了和 AI 说话
items.summary: An essay (2,013 points, 950 comments on Hacker News) in which the author says he wants to talk to real people, yet even the people he talks to forward his questions to AI and send back AI's answer.

items.title: Disagreement among frontier LLMs on real-world fact-checks
items.title_zh: 前沿大模型在真实世界事实核查上的分歧
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (505 points, 347 comments) of a Lenz study finding that 63% of real-world claims expose disagreement among the five top frontier LLMs, published alongside methodology, breakdowns and a data CSV.

items.title: GTA 6 Developers Unionize
items.title_zh: GTA 6 开发者成立工会
items.summary: Rockstar staff members and the Independent Workers' Union of Great Britain announced the Rockstar Game Workers Union, which will contest Rockstar Games' actions in court. The Hacker News submission drew 758 points and 537 comments.

items.title: AI job grief: A psychological crisis hitting tech workers
items.title_zh: AI 岗位悲悼：冲击科技从业者的心理危机
items.summary: Hacker News front page (201 points, 205 comments) on a blog post arguing that, across hundreds of Reddit threads and a small clinical literature, AI-driven job displacement is producing an emotional category that closely resembles grief.

items.title: Openrsync: An implementation of rsync, by the OpenBSD team
items.title_zh: Openrsync：OpenBSD 团队打造的 rsync 实现
items.summary: Hacker News front page (492 points, 185 comments) discusses kristapsdz/openrsync, a BSD-licensed implementation of rsync by the OpenBSD team, hosted on GitHub for contributors to its development.

items.title: 'Backrooms' Stuns with $81M Debut
items.title_zh: 《Backrooms》首映豪取 8100 万美元
items.summary: Variety reports the film “Backrooms” stunned with an $81 million debut, part of a record moviegoing weekend fueled by “Backrooms” and “Obsession” as Star Wars crumbled. Hacker News: 224 points, 186 comments.

items.title: Learn SQL Once, Use It for 30 Years
items.title_zh: 学一次 SQL，用三十年
items.summary: Essay by Fagner Brack arguing that SQL is a durable skill worth learning once, because it has stayed useful through three decades of database and tooling churn. Hacker News: 323 points, 231 comments.

items.title: With Claude: Less Coding, More Testing
items.title_zh: 用 Claude 之后：代码写得更少，测试做得更多
items.summary: Developer blog post describing how, after a few months with Claude Code, the author writes much less code and spends more time understanding and testing what Claude produces. Hacker News: 29 points, 4 comments.

items.title: Anthropic Cofounder Chris Olah's Remarks on Pope Leo XIV's "Magnifica Humanitas"
items.title_zh: Anthropic 联合创始人 Chris Olah 就教宗良十四世《Magnifica Humanitas》的发言
items.summary: Anthropic published the full text of co-founder Chris Olah's remarks on Pope Leo XIV's encyclical on AI, Magnifica Humanitas, in a post that drew 87 points and 99 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: SQLite is all you need for durable workflows
items.title_zh: 做持久化工作流，SQLite 就够了
items.summary: Post responding to DBOS's argument that Postgres alone suffices for durable execution, making the case that SQLite is all you need for durable workflows instead of a separate orchestration tier. It drew 720 points and 387 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Zig: Build System Reworked
items.title_zh: Zig：构建系统重做
items.summary: Hacker News front page (362 points, 249 comments) on the Zig devlog entry dated 2026-05-26 that announces a reworked build system for the Zig programming language.

items.title: Norway's 2 petabytes of Huawei flash storage and LLM training
items.title_zh: 挪威的 2PB 华为闪存与 LLM 训练
items.summary: Blocks & Files report that Norway's National Library is developing a large language model that understands Norwegian, backed by two petabytes of Huawei flash storage; the story drew 324 points and 215 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Trump's 25% cut on Nvidia chips to China backfired as Beijing blocks H200 sales
items.title_zh: 特朗普对华英伟达芯片加征 25% 反而适得其反，北京阻止 H200 销售
items.summary: Yahoo Finance reports Donald Trump said Beijing has refused to approve purchases of Nvidia's H200 AI chips because China wants to develop its own, after a 25% US cut on chip sales to China backfired; 21 points on Hacker News.

items.title: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan is Now Globally Available
items.title_zh: 小米 MiMo Token 套餐面向全球开放
items.summary: Xiaomi's MiMo platform made its Token Plan globally available, bundling flagship-performance, full-modality model access for professional workflows with team plans and batch inference; 79 points and 57 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: Xiaomi MiMo-v2.5 Series API Permanent Price Reduction Up to 99%
items.title_zh: 小米 MiMo-v2.5 系列 API 永久降价，最高降幅 99%
items.summary: Xiaomi's MiMo platform announced a permanent API price reduction of up to 99% for the MiMo-v2.5 series, alongside team token plans and batch inference now powered by V2.6 models; 134 points and 160 comments on Hacker News.

items.title: I cut my AI API costs 99% by switching from Claude to DeepSeek
items.title_zh: 我从 Claude 换到 DeepSeek，把 AI API 成本砍掉了 99%
items.summary: Hacker News discussion (27 points, 17 comments) of a developer's post claiming he cut agent API costs from over $200 a month to $2-3 by switching from Claude to DeepSeek Flash and replacing GitHub Actions with a free cron job.

items.title: Claude Opus 4.8 distilled Alibaba Qwen models
items.title_zh: Claude Opus 4.8 蒸馏了阿里巴巴 Qwen 模型
items.summary: X post noting that when asked in Chinese through the API who it is, Claude Opus 4.8 often answers that it is Qwen, Alibaba's Tongyi Lab model, prompting jokes about distillation. Hacker News score: 23 points, 7 comments.

items.title: AhmadHassan-BTed/EQAI
items.title_zh: EQAI：将《无尽的任务》角色模型移植进 PS2 引擎的逆向工程管线
items.summary: A Python reverse-engineering pipeline that structurally transplants original EverQuest character models into the EverQuest Online Adventures: Frontiers PlayStation 2 engine, resolving VU1 shader bugs, Emotion Engine memory overflows and CDVDman hardware faults. 2,424 stars.

items.title: ace-trump-tech/MindPaw
items.title_zh: MindPaw：基于 ESP8266 的开源桌面四足机器狗
items.summary: GitHub trending C++ project MindPaw is an open-source ESP8266 desktop quadruped robot dog supporting voice, gesture and web control, Doubao AI conversation and PAD emotion interaction; 2,687 stars and 2,260 forks.

items.title: backnotprop/pstack
items.title_zh: backnotprop/pstack：面向严谨 AI 辅助工程的技能与原则
items.summary: pstack packages skills and principles for rigorous AI-assisted engineering, built for use with Claude, Codex and pi. The JavaScript repository has 2,805 stars and 212 forks and is tagged agent-skills and claude-code.

items.title: hhyqhh/inno-agent
items.title_zh: inno-agent：基于三层记忆的开源个人学习智能体
items.summary: Trending GitHub project with 1,307 stars that builds an open-source personal learning agent on the Pi SDK, with three-layer memory spanning a learner profile, a wiki knowledge base and cross-conversation recall, plus a proactive scheduler.

items.title: jdevalk/specification.website
items.title_zh: jdevalk/specification.website：网站规范清单
items.summary: MIT-licensed, platform-agnostic website specification covering HTML, accessibility, security, SEO and agent-readiness, built with TypeScript and Astro and deployed on Cloudflare Pages. The repository has 912 stars and 54 forks.

items.title: liyue-aigc/female-portrait-director
items.title_zh: liyue-aigc/female-portrait-director：人像提示词 Codex 技能
items.summary: GitHub Trending modular Codex Skill for directing and expanding detailed AI female portrait prompts, tagged for AI image generation and prompt engineering; it has 1,678 stars and 206 forks.

items.title: HarnessMD/munder-difflin
items.title_zh: HarnessMD/munder-difflin：在你的笔记本上跑一支 Claude Code/Codex 智能体团队
items.summary: TypeScript open-source alternative to hosted agent platforms that runs an office of Claude Code and Codex agents on your laptop or sandboxes using existing subscriptions. 9,063 GitHub stars, 1,262 forks.

items.title: odysseus-dev/odysseus
items.title_zh: odysseus-dev/odysseus：自托管 AI 工作空间
items.summary: Python self-hosted AI workspace whose entire GitHub description reads “Self-hosted AI workspace,” carrying 94,449 stars and 1,755 forks, making it one of the most-starred projects on the trending list.

items.title: Jane-xiaoer/claude-skill-web-clone
items.title_zh: claude-skill-web-clone：忠实克隆任意网站的方法论
items.summary: Trending GitHub project with 1,075 stars offering a Claude Code skill methodology for faithfully cloning static, React or WebGL websites by starting from real page source instead of AI-hallucinated code.

items.title: loopx-project/loopx
items.title_zh: loopx-project/loopx：把长期目标变成可验证的结果
items.summary: Python local-first semantic control plane and research workbench for long-running agent teams that turns long-horizon goals into verifiable results across sessions and runtimes. 6,428 GitHub stars, 612 forks.

items.title: From Seeing to Thinking: Decoupling Perception and Reasoning Improves Post-Training of Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 从“看”到“想”：解耦感知与推理改进视觉语言模型后训练
items.summary: A study that splits VLM post-training into visual perception, visual reasoning and textual reasoning stages, finding staged training beats merged training and yields 1.5% higher reasoning accuracy with 20.8% shorter reasoning traces. 4 upvotes.

items.title: LongAV-Compass: Towards Unified Evaluation of Minute-Scale Audio-Visual Generation Across T2AV, I2AV, and V2AV
items.title_zh: LongAV-Compass：统一评测分钟级音视频生成（T2AV、I2AV、V2AV）
items.summary: KlingAI Research's benchmark holds 284 curated cases for minute-long audio-visual generation conditioned on text, image or video, scoring more than 20 dimensions such as cross-segment consistency, narrative coherence and audio-visual synchronization using MLLM and perceptual metrics.

items.title: YoCausal: How Far is Video Generation from World Model? A Causality Perspective
items.title_zh: YoCausal：视频生成离世界模型还有多远？一个因果视角
items.summary: Benchmark from Alaya Lab that temporally reverses real videos as free counterfactuals to test whether video diffusion models understand causality rather than only the arrow of time. Across 13 state-of-the-art models, temporal perception did not imply causal reasoning.

items.title: DVAO: Dynamic Variance-adaptive Advantage Optimization for Multi-reward Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: DVAO：多奖励强化学习的动态方差自适应优势优化
items.summary: DVAO is a multi-reward reinforcement learning method for LLM alignment that weights objectives by empirical reward variance, keeping advantage magnitudes bounded and avoiding the instability plain reward combination causes under GRPO; 47 upvotes.

items.title: LLaVA-OneVision-2: Towards Next-Generation Perceptual Intelligence
items.title_zh: LLaVA-OneVision-2：迈向下一代感知智能
items.summary: The newest model in the LLaVA-OneVision series uses codec-stream tokenization and windowed attention for long video, pretrained on roughly 8M re-captioned video samples. Its 8B variant reaches 74.9 JumpScore mAP against 30.1 for Qwen3-VL-8B.

items.title: LLMs as Noisy Channels: A Shannon Perspective on Model Capacity and Scaling Laws
items.title_zh: 把 LLM 视作噪声信道：模型容量与缩放定律的香农视角
items.summary: A paper modelling LLM training as information transmission over a noisy channel via the Shannon-Hartley theorem, explaining catastrophic overtraining and quantization degradation, and extrapolating to unseen model and token scales better than monotonic laws. 10 upvotes.

items.title: QUEST: Training Frontier Deep Research Agents with Fully Synthetic Tasks
items.title_zh: QUEST：用全合成任务训练前沿深度研究智能体
items.summary: OSU NLP Group releases QUEST, an open family of 2B to 35B deep research agents trained with synthesized tasks, mid-training, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, targeting fact seeking, citation grounding and report synthesis; 43 Hugging Face upvotes.

items.title: Rethinking VLM Representation for VLA Initialization
items.title_zh: 重新思考用于 VLA 初始化的 VLM 表征
items.summary: A CUHK study treats VLA initialization as a controlled representation-design problem across embodied VQA supervision, parameter-update strategy and robot-data pretraining. LoRA initializes more reliably than full fine-tuning, and staged LoRA training with robot data gives the strongest variant.

items.title: ProRL: Effective Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Recommendation via Rectified Policy Gradient Estimation
items.title_zh: ProRL：通过修正策略梯度估计实现主动推荐的高效强化学习
items.summary: Fudan University researchers propose ProRL, an RL framework for proactive recommender systems that adds stepwise reward centering and position-specific advantage estimation to remove gradient bias and variance, outperforming state-of-the-art methods on three real-world datasets.

items.title: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models
items.title_zh: minWM：面向实时交互式视频世界模型的全栈开源框架
items.summary: Full-stack open-source pipeline that converts bidirectional text-to-video and image-to-video diffusion models into camera-controllable, few-step autoregressive world models through causal forcing and distillation, instantiated on Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B and HY1.5-TI2V-8B. 57 Hugging Face upvotes and 863 GitHub stars.
